The Lyca mPOS application is intended to facilitate the sale and distribution of mobile simcards, without the need for access to a POS terminal. Using a mobile app allows for more flexibility and convenience when making sales in the field. The application facilitates obligatory SIM user identity registration according to Belgian legislation.

The app allows Merchants to sell, activate and distribute simcards to customers. The app also maintains log transactions, keeps track of credit limits and outstanding invoices, and request reports.
